title: Register for PAYG withholding
what: Register with the ATO as a withholder by the day the business first has to withhold tax, usually from employees' wages.

sources.title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
sources.locator: Schedule 1, s 16-140(1) (compilation C2026C00468, in force from 2026-10-01)
sources.quote: (b) Subdivision 14-A, 14-B, 14-C or 14-D (about payments in respect of non-cash benefits or capital proceeds); must apply to register with the Commissioner.

sources.title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
sources.locator: Schedule 1, s 16-140(2) (compilation C2026C00468, in force from 2026-10-01)
sources.quote: The entity must apply in the *approved form by the day on which the entity is first required: (a) to withhold an amount under Division 12;

triggers.note: Strictly, the day the business is first required to withhold, which for most is the first payment of wages.

sources.title: Taxation Administration Act 1953
sources.locator: Schedule 1, s 16-140(1) (compilation C2026C00468, in force from 2026-10-01)
sources.quote: 16-140 Withholders must be registered (1) An entity that must pay an amount to the Commissioner under:

assessment.summary: An employer must register for PAYG withholding, withhold tax from employees' pay and pass it to the ATO.

marks.reason: Withholding tax from each pay and remitting it to the ATO.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 7 Nov 2026, not yet checked by a person.
